offers_products.reason: AsureCentral cloud payroll, HR, benefits and time-tracking software sold on subscription.

offers_services.reason: AsureWorks managed payroll, tax filing, HR compliance and benefits administration delivered by Asure specialists.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are employers buying payroll and HR software and services, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells payroll, HR and benefits platform and services to small and midsize businesses (100,000+ clients).

recurring_revenue.reason: Cloud subscriptions and ongoing per-payroll managed services are repeated every pay cycle.

cyclical_demand.reason: Payroll, tax filing and HR compliance are mandatory and must continue in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Small recurring subscription and per-payroll fees, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value mainly comes from the AsureCentral platform and payroll tax infrastructure, though AsureWorks adds staff-delivered services.

large_customers.reason: Targets small and growing businesses and entrepreneurs, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Cloud software and service delivery needs offices and development, not plants, fleets or networks.
